Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the specific list of Fidelity international emerging markets equity mutual funds with $0 transaction fees from the initial search results. Instead of identifying the relevant funds (beyond just FEMKX), it only provided a general search result summary and clicked on a single fund link without gathering the comprehensive list required to compare performance. This early failure to extract the necessary data set led to a prolonged and ineffective search process where the agent repeatedly attempted to find more funds without success, ultimately resulting in an incomplete analysis based on insufficient data.
